questions.text: Please introduce yourself and summarize your frontend experience.
What is the virtual DOM, and how does React use it?
Explain the difference between controlled and uncontrolled components in React.
How do you manage state in a medium-sized React application?
What strategies do you use to optimize rendering performance in React?
How would you implement client-side form validation with accessible error messages?
Describe how you would structure a design system or shared component library.
A page is loading slowly. Walk me through how you would diagnose and improve it.
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a design or product decision. How did you handle it?
How do you collaborate with designers and backend engineers on a feature?
How do you approach accessibility (a11y) in your day-to-day frontend work?
What is responsive design, and which CSS techniques do you rely on most?
